Task card at scratch/task-card.md; handoff at outbox/handoff.md; journal note saved. Table kept portable (not placed) to respect reserved interior/entrance clearance for later leaves.

Prep_wood leaf (spec rev 2) complete. Fresh observation confirmed starting state: 33 birch_log + 2 birch_planks, overworld (28.5, 104.0, -1.5), day, no threats. Verified recipe via recipe_search (1 birch_log -> 4 birch_planks, no table required). Task card at scratch/task-card.md, handoff at outbox/handoff.md, journal note saved. No recovery active. Next project leaf: site_survey.

Crafted a stone pickaxe using available cobblestone and sticks. Crafted 2 stick recipes (-4 planks 74->70, +8 sticks 4->12), then placed crafting table at (30,103,-3) outside spawn area, crafted stone_pickaxe x1 (-3 cobblestone 4->1, -2 sticks 12->10, +1 stone_pickaxe), mined table back into inventory. Inventory: 70 birch_planks, 15 birch_log, 10 stick, 1 cobblestone, 3 dirt, 2 wooden_pickaxe, 1 birch_sapling, 1 crafting_table, 1 rotten_flesh, 1 stone_pickaxe. Criterion sp_stone_pickaxe (minimum 1 stone_pickaxe in inventory) satisfied.

Next project leaf: house_build (note: 64 planks on hand may be short of the ~84 needed for floor+walls+roof; convert the 15 birch_log first).

All 25 target cells at y=103 (x=28..32, z=-1..3) are air. No vegetation is present in the target box. Nearest vegetation is 5+ blocks away. The floor_clear leaf criterion is satisfied.

The door approach cell (27,103,1) is also birch_planks. The floor is supported by dirt/grass_block at y=102. The interior (y=104) and door approach clearance (y=104-105) are preserved as air. Player is safe at (30.21, 104.0, 1.81), health 18/20, no recovery active. Task card at scratch/task-card.md, handoff at outbox/handoff.md.

Crafted an iron pickaxe from smelted iron ingots. The player had 6 iron_ingot and 12 stick in inventory at (30,104,1). Walked to (29.5,104,5.3) to reach the crafting table at (30,102,6), opened the table window, and crafted 1 iron_pickaxe (consuming 3 iron_ingot + 2 sticks). Verified via count_inventory: 1 iron_pickaxe in inventory. All three criteria met: ip_pickaxe (iron_pickaxe=1), ip_smelt (accepted prerequisite), ip_mine (accepted prerequisite).

Built the two-block-high outer birch-plank walls at levels 104 and 105 (x=28..32, z=-1..3) and installed a birch wooden door in the west-side two-cell entrance at (28,104,1)+(28,105,1). All 30 wall cells verified birch_planks except the two door cells which are birch_door; all 18 interior cells verified air; both approach cells (27,104,1)+(27,105,1) verified air.
